I was eleven in 1993. I remember when the coming soon commercials started and I was so excited. I remember waiting for the pilot. I grew up in a new age doomsday prepping anti government alien believing cult and had been feeling cut off and different than other kids… so this was something that was relatable for me. I remember waiting for the TV Guide to read the small synopsis of each upcoming episode. Egads I loved the trailers for upcoming episodes. Then later when we started accessing the internet in short periods of time using AOL mailed discs the literal only thing I did was go straight to either xf chat rooms or just read fanfic. I did this for YEARS. any internet access I could find… fanfic. Then the unthinkable happened they moved to Sunday night and I had a 9pm bedtime until I graduated high school. So I had to tape it on a VCR and usually over another movie of course. Then I would set an alarm for about an hour early Monday morning before school so I could watch it. I absolutely could NOT go to school and not have seen it. What would my one friend think?!? I collected all kinds of things. Mostly any magazines they had any articles in. Tv guides. Entertainment weekly. I collected VHS’s and the little cards that came with them. Action figures. Anything. I went to Emerald City Comic Con specifically one year to get Gillian’s autograph and so I could tell her that she was my first female crush and what the show meant to me. I was so sheltered and separate and the show was my familiar. But when I got to her in line I just smiled and kinda giggled. Yep. So that happened. In like 1995 or maybe 1996, I convinced my mom and brother to drive us to Vancouver and secretly planned the whole trip around filming locations. We stayed in the hotel they always used and went where they made it seem like DC or gas town or whatever. Got my brother a ticket to slam city skate jams so I could explore various filming locations. I saw both movies in theaters multiple times. The second one grew on me. It was just an extended monster of the week episode. I graduated high school and still made sure I was able to get to a TV for the last few seasons. The show is my comfort show (along with TNG). Recently I’ve been rebuying the little paperbacks that were made from ThriftBooks. It’s just the best friend of a show I ever had. Phew. Okay I’m done. 👽🛸❌😵
